$comment: Social platform limits that scripts enforce and prose quotes. One value per fact, each with where it was read. Scripts read it through _common.platform_spec(); prose points here instead of restating a number, and tests/test_platform_specs.py fails when a doc states one of these facts with another number, and 30 days before any review_by. A field not re-read this round has verified_on null and an early review_by, so the check sends someone back to the vendor page. A REPORTED note means the vendor page could not be read and the value rests on the quoted statement.
schema: each field: value, source_url, source_date (the source's own date, null when undated), verified_on (when this value was last checked against the source, null if not this round), review_by, note

caption_display_chars.note: Characters shown before 'more' on a feed post. Carried from 3.39.1.

hashtags_cap.note: REPORTED: Instagram's @creators account, 2025-12-18: 'Starting today, Instagram will allow up to 5 hashtags in a reel or post' (quoted by Social Media Today and Betanews, 2025-12-19). help.instagram.com/351460621611097 still shows the old 30.

hashtags_advised.note: Practice within the cap: one broad, specific and niche tags.

reel_max_seconds.note: REPORTED: reels can be recorded and edited up to 20 minutes (help page quoted by the search index; it is JavaScript-only from here).

reel_recommended_max_seconds.note: REPORTED: reels over 3 minutes are not recommended to new audiences.

post_chars.note: REPORTED: no Meta page states a post character limit (re-read 2026-10-28). SocialKit's counter gives 63,206 (it says verified June 2026), a figure that traces to a 2011 Facebook remark. Write far shorter; the fold, not the cap, is what limits a post.

post_display_chars.note: REPORTED: characters shown before 'See more' on desktop. No Meta page states it; SocialKit gives about 477 on desktop and about 125 on mobile and calls both approximate (line breaks and the surface move the fold).

image_max_mb.note: Photo uploads to a Page: 'Files can not exceed 10MB. For .png files, we recommend not exceeding 1MB.' Formats: .jpeg, .bmp, .png, .gif, .tiff. Link-share preview images must not exceed 8 MB; 30 MB is the Meta ads figure (meta-ads.md). platform-specs.md said 30 MB and WebP before 3.40.0.

story_video_seconds.note: Page Stories API: a story video is .mp4, 9:16, 1080x1920 recommended (minimum 540x960), '3 to 90 seconds'; a reel published as a story 'can not exceed 60 seconds'. Meta states no video file size. Story ads are a separate product (meta-ads.md).

story_photo_max_mb.note: Page Stories API: a story photo 'can not exceed 10MB' (.jpeg, .bmp, .png, .gif, .tiff).

story_text_chars_advised.note: Practice, not a platform cap: Meta states no character limit for story text. 250 keeps an overlay readable on a phone. Before 3.41.0 the formatter carried 250 with no source and allowed 5 hashtags on a story, against 1-3 for a post.

reel_max_seconds.note: Meta newsroom post of 2025-06-17. No length limit: 'all videos on Facebook will be shared as reels ... Reels on Facebook will also not have any length or format restrictions' (updated 2025-07-14; completion end of September 2025 is REPORTED).

topic_tags_cap.note: Threads API docs: 'Only one topic tag is allowed per post.' Topic tags render without the #.

links_cap.note: Threads changelog, 2025-12-22: five links per post.

post_chars.note: 'Posts can contain up to 3,000 characters.' LinkedIn's help shows only a relative date (updated about three weeks before the read).

post_display_chars.note: About 140 on mobile, 210 on desktop before 'see more'. Carried from 3.39.1.

article_chars.note: 'Articles ... are limited to 125,000 characters.' This file said 120,000 before 3.40.0 while platform-specs.md said 125,000. The page shows a relative date only.

image_max_mb.note: A photo in a post: 'The size limit for an upload is 5 MB.' LinkedIn's Media file types page (answer a564109) gives a generic 100 MB cap and 36 megapixels for all media; 5 MB is the only figure LinkedIn gives for a photo in a post. platform-specs.md said 8 MB before 3.40.0.

post_chars.note: 'Compose your message (up to 280 characters)'. Emoji and CJK characters count as 2 (docs.x.com/fundamentals/counting-characters). Longer posts for X Premium: 25,000 on two help pages, 4,000 on How to Post, all dated 2026-10-12.

hashtags_advised.note: X's own recommendation, not a cap: 'We recommend using no more than 2 hashtags per post as best practice, but you may use as many hashtags in a post as you like.' Hashtags spend the character budget.

links_advised.note: Practice. A link counts as 23 characters (twitter.link_chars).

link_chars.note: 'All URLs are wrapped with t.co shortener and count as 23 characters, regardless of the original length.' X's ad specs (help.x.com, 2026-09-28) say the same.

caption_chars.note: REPORTED: TikTok's Content Posting API reference (direct post) caps a video caption, the title field, at 2,200 UTF-16 runes, and hashtags and mentions are parsed from it (quoted by the search index on 2026-10-29; developers.tiktok.com does not load from India). The 4,000 that third-party pages give is the photo-post description (photo_description_chars), not a video caption; no TikTok page gives 4,000 for a video.

photo_description_chars.note: REPORTED: the photo-post reference caps a photo post's description at 4,000 UTF-16 runes (quoted by the search index on 2026-10-29).

photo_title_chars.note: REPORTED: the photo-post reference caps a photo post's title at 90 UTF-16 runes (quoted by the search index on 2026-10-29).

video_max_seconds.note: In-app uploads up to 10 minutes. Carried from 3.39.1.

post_chars.note: The post lexicon's text field: maxGraphemes 300 (maxLength 3,000 bytes). The lexicons moved to packages/api/lexicons/ on 2026-10-15; the old lexicons/ path returns 404.

hashtags_advised.note: Practice, not a platform cap. The lexicons set no count for hashtags in the text: each tag facet is at most 64 graphemes, and the tags count toward the post's 300. Discovery runs on custom feeds and search, so keep them few. The old source, docs.bsky.app, renders only with JavaScript.

extra_tags_cap.note: The post record's tags field: 'Additional hashtags, in addition to any included in post text and facets', maxLength 8, each at most 64 graphemes. They do not show in the text and do not count toward the 300.

video_max_seconds.note: Shorts up to 3 minutes. Since 2025-03-31 a Short's view counts when it starts to play or replay; the old metric is 'engaged views'.
